prompt_pattern: mission-oriented autonomous build grounded in repository source of truth; reference implementations named; no artificial owner checkpoints
human_signal: strongly positive; user emphasized single-prompt success and ~92% of one five-hour usage window
outcome: accepted and used as the tasking model for Modular CRM
lesson: mature repositories can benefit from broad mission-oriented autonomous prompts more than milestone micromanagement

prompt_pattern: repository-grounded bounded feature implementation with tests
human_signal: user explicitly praised output cost versus accuracy/content creation
outcome: merged; pattern reused for additional foundations
lesson: cost-efficient capable implementers are strong defaults for bounded repository work, but integration still benefits from independent review

prompt_pattern: large autonomous remediation wave, later reviewer/orchestrator use
human_signal: user questioned cost efficiency after roughly 12 hours across three five-hour windows; preferred reviewer/orchestrator role later
lesson: a capable model can be the wrong economic default for giant implementation; reserve expensive reasoning for bottlenecks where it adds marginal value

prompt_pattern: multi-model bake-off on project skill/governance design
human_signal: Claude response judged strongest for separating Sacred Event Protection review from authorship
lesson: use frontier reasoning for role/authority design when semantic drift is costly; deterministic formatting belongs in scripts

prompt_pattern: concise invariant-centered prompt: adapters, stable IDs, no duplicate authority, bounded playtest
human_signal: verbose prompt rejected; concise prompt accepted; run judged strong
lesson: environment-aware coding agents gain value from live MCP access when authority boundaries are explicit

prompt_pattern: repository-local prompt skill selecting text/image/multiview/T-pose methods; downstream-cleanup aware; no unsupported topology guarantees
human_signal: early visual reference rejected as garbage; later direction became more construction/material specific
outcome: prompt discipline reused and adapted to Adventurer's Rise
lesson: optimize generative-3D prompts for silhouette, construction, reuse, and cleanup; learn standards from measured outputs instead of promising production readiness

prompt_pattern: generate then measure representative assets; update catalog ceilings from evidence
human_signal: approved shift away from outdated speculative budgets
outcome: 13-bin living production catalog and later face-limit derivation
lesson: generative asset pipelines improve when outputs feed empirical technical standards

prompt_pattern: autonomous local build/test/package followed by owner QC
human_signal: Phase 1 succeeded but playtest exposed pay schedule, due-date, category, balance, interest, backup/restore, naming, and graph issues
outcome: targeted correction prompt produced from actual use
lesson: get to a usable build early, then let real product friction drive the next prompt

prompt_pattern: review existing deterministic baseline, preserve it, add modular adaptive model with leakage safeguards
outcome: adaptive probabilistic layer added without replacing fixed baseline
lesson: review-driven extension should preserve a known baseline so new intelligence can be compared rather than silently replacing the reference

agent_harness: Claude Code via claude.ai Projects + Remote Control on owner's Windows machine
prompt_pattern: long structured audit briefs: named invariant, risk areas, do-not-trust-the-author, verdict vocabulary, review-only boundaries
human_signal: PR #3 approved after one external-review correction; PR #5 and #6 audits accepted and both PRs merged after one fix round
outcome: 4 reproduced defects fixed in PR #3; external review found a missing location-scope check in Claude's own fix
lesson: an independent cross-model debugging/audit pass finds real defects that survived the author's tests, but the reviewer's own fixes still need independent review

model_label: claude-opus-5-5 (effort medium) auditing GPT-6.1 Sol (owner label)
agent_harness: claude.ai Projects thread + hourly routine + GitHub @codex PR comments; Codex app session
prompt_pattern: self-contained @codex task comments; loop protocol stored in repo doc; independent re-run of every check before verdict
human_signal: owner merged every approved PR (#7-#28); later said the loop over-hardened slices
resource_signal: platform-reported metered usage ~$167 for the loop thread; Claude five-hour and seven-day limits hit; Codex usage limits reported; ~45 idle hourly polls
outcome: 22 PRs in ~74h; stacked bases sent 11 of 12 merges to intermediate branches (roll-up PR #21); loop stalled from 2026-10-08 on implementer availability
lesson: cross-model build/review loop is effective at catching security and money defects, but needs an always-on implementer runtime, main-based PRs, and a second reviewer

prompt_pattern: owner replaced BLOCKER/SHOULD FIX/FOLLOW-UP/NIT with BLOCKER/1.0 FIX/HARDEN LATER and made Claude lead orchestrator with six-part Codex briefs
artifact: PLAN_1_0.md in the project's shared files (9 BLOCKERs, 14-18 PR wave plan) from five parallel Agent code audits
verification: two subsequent PRs (#29, #30) reviewed under the new taxonomy
human_signal: explicit correction: the workflow 'encouraged deep hardening of individual slices and repeated expansion into adjacent edge cases'
outcome: plan produced in ~10 minutes; effect on cycle time not yet measurable because the implementer stalled
lesson: set the review taxonomy from the owner's milestone up front; 'should fix blocks merge' plus folded follow-ups ratchets toward hardening
